description: Offer to share a completed run. action=preview returns the exact public page (scrubbed timeline, receipt, price, remix link) and stores nothing; show it to the user. action=publish makes it public at alterlab.io/r/<slug> and needs approve=true, which only the user may give after seeing the preview. Pages are noindex unless indexable=true. action=unpublish makes the link return 404; publish again to reuse the slug.

approve.description: Publish: the user approved this public page

indexable.description: Let search engines index the page; default false

name: alterlab_hands_share
title: Hands Share Run
